question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Outweigh**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Outweigh **means to be more important, valuable, or significant than something else. (किसी अन्य चीज़ से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण, मूल्यवान या महत्वपूर्ण)
 
• It is a verb and is often used in the context of comparing two things or options.
 
 
• **Example**: The benefits of exercise outwei
